question: Does serializing the full native PR identity overbind the continuation target?
setup: Known captured PR; alter only title, keeping repository/PR/base/head identical
finding: Full PR serialization includes descriptive metadata and would reject a metadata-only refresh as target_changed
decision: Use only repository/PR/base/head for the real-trial opaque target token; native metadata remains retained evidence. Dependency/material changes remain basis checks. No product source or contract change.
